options.B: 1 mol e⁻ (iron only)
options.C: 2 mol e⁻ (ethanedioate only)
options.D: 5 mol e⁻ (copied from MnO₄⁻)

followup.why: Fe²⁺ loses 1e⁻ and C₂O₄²⁻ loses 2e⁻, so 1 mol FeC₂O₄ loses 3 mol e⁻. MnO₄⁻ gains 5e⁻. Combine those counts before using a listed value.
